subject.title: fix: preserve BOOTSTRAP.md in preseeded workspaces (#91931)

question: Should an existing `BOOTSTRAP.md` with no `setupCompletedAt` ignore profile-file and workspace-skill evidence across restarts, requiring memory/MEMORY evidence or explicit bootstrap removal before completion?
rationale: This fixes silent onboarding loss for managed workspaces but deliberately disables an existing stale-bootstrap repair heuristic for some upgraded workspaces, so code review alone cannot choose the compatibility contract.

options.title: Accept narrowed evidence
options.body: Document the rule and land the PR so pending bootstrap remains authoritative over profile and skill preseeding.

options.title: Require explicit managed mode
options.body: Preserve profile-diff repair by default and pause for a separately approved managed-workspace mode despite the added config surface.

recommendation.title: Accept narrowed evidence
recommendation.body: Document the rule and land the PR so pending bootstrap remains authoritative over profile and skill preseeding.

likelyOwner.reason: The behavior appears to originate in their stale-bootstrap repair work, giving them the strongest history-based context for this contract choice.
